<reason>B won by making the live clash easier to decide: the right as written is a thin AI badge, and A’s harm story (burial to sell boosts, loaded odds, self-blame vs the machine) needed facts that badge never states. B held the motion to ranking-as-product, emptiness, and an arbitrary AI trigger, then used A’s concessions—that the sentence does not say you were penalized, and that secret human grading would also be wrong—to show the material claim was being smuggled in. A was vivid on intimacy and modest notice, but never closed that gap.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B’s second rebuttal: A admits the label never says they were penalized, then loads “rigged game/loaded odds”; B answers that “computers run the tables” is not loaded odds, so the notice still cannot separate burial from a thin room.</best_rebuttal>
